description: What a referrer address has accrued from routing swaps, plus the UNSIGNED claim transactions (send them from the referrer wallet). Referral rewards accrue in the OUTPUT token of each swap. USDC-paired coins pay into the ReferralEscrow: buys accrue the coin, sells accrue USDC. v3 coins pay into the v3 ReferralEscrow: buys accrue the coin, sells accrue the pair token (gold, XAUm, first). USDC and every pair token are always checked; pass the coins you referred to check those too. Amounts are human units; amountRaw is smallest units.

coins.description: Coins you referred trades in, to check their balances too (up to 20); USDC and every pair token are always checked

name: get_referrer_balance
